rows.label: Other key data / assumptions: Discount rate
rows.explainer: Ambitious Impact discounts at 0.04 a year. Linked to the shared discount rate (Your values); the evaluator view pins it to Ambitious Impact's rate.

rows.label: Overhead - Year 1 (Expected)
rows.explainer: Best guess (Held constant in all CEAs)

rows.label: How long charity runs if unsuccessful
Overhead - Scale (Expected)
rows.explainer: Best guess (Default, can vary)

rows.label: How long charity program runs if successful
rows.explainer: We assume a five year run for the charity in a specific location, driven mainly due to worries about message exhaustion or dimishing effects. This is highly conservative assumption.

rows.label: Probability of success
rows.explainer: This accounts for our internal estimate of how likely a non-profit is to be successful in implementation. I.e., succesfully delivering the program, not the effects of the program itself. Failure modes include not being able to partner with radio stations, for instance.

rows.explainer: VAWG_cost-effectiveness estimates Drawn from Akhil Bansal's work, who wrote: "Based on an aggregate of several studies - IWPR, Peterson et al 2018 and European Centre for Gender Equality  . Note that most of these are done in higher income countries and so might not be as relevant in LMIC, where most of the other economic effects are modelled. Practically, I think this means in LMIC, you might have less legal costs, but likely healthcare costs are higher due to relative cost of health compared to income. On balance, therefore, I think this estimate is reasonable."

summary: Ambitious Impact's 2023 estimate (2024 idea report) for a new charity broadcasting entertainment-led radio and TV drama that shifts attitudes to prevent intimate partner violence. The idea Novah was founded to run. Its bottom line is the cost per DALY-equivalent averted in Angola, the modelled country closest to AIM's four-country average (about $79); AIM counts women's lost income in it at 0.43 DALYs per year of doubled consumption (1/2.3, GiveWell's rate; 'Standard inputs'!B13).

theoretical.reason: Ambitious Impact's estimate of the idea, written before the charity existed; not based on the charity's own results.
theoretical.runs: Novah broadcasts radio drama to prevent intimate partner violence in Rwanda, under an RCT; AIM modelled radio and TV in Angola.
